explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/425, second question: if A ⊆ {1,…,n} is such that all products a_1⋯a_r with a_1 < ⋯ < a_r are distinct, is |A| ≤ π(n) + O(n^{(r+1)/(2r)})? In Lean RProductsDistinct r A says any two r-element subsets of A with equal product are equal (exactly the source condition), and the statement is ∀ r ≥ 1, ∃ C > 0, eventually in n, every such A ⊆ Icc 1 n has |A| ≤ π(n) + C·n^{(r+1)/(2r)}. The implied constant may depend on r (∃ C after ∀ r), the natural reading. The case r = 1 is trivially true (bound π(n) + Cn), which is harmless. Faithful.
